summary: Tested image drag-resize and delete controls in RTF editor. All features working correctly: image selection with cyan border, red delete button, cyan resize handle, resize by drag, delete functionality, and deselection by clicking outside.
passed_tests: ✅ Click on image in RTF editor selects the image
✅ Selected image shows cyan border (outline: 3px solid #22d3ee)
✅ Red delete button (data-testid='rtf-image-delete-btn') appears in top-right corner when image selected
✅ Cyan resize handle (data-testid='rtf-image-resize-handle') appears in bottom-right corner when image selected
✅ Delete button (Trash2 icon) is clickable and removes image from editor
✅ Resize handle is draggable and resizes image maintaining aspect ratio
✅ Image resized from 250x150 to 340x204 - aspect ratio maintained
✅ Clicking outside the image deselects it (removes 'selected-image' class)
✅ Controls (delete button, resize handle) are hidden when image is deselected
✅ Image hover state shows dashed outline (outline: 2px dashed #64748b)
✅ Content is updated after resize/delete operations (onChange callback)

feature_verification.access_path: Dashboard -> Click project 'Curso demo' -> Click 'Texto com IA' button (data-testid='add-rich-text-btn') -> Insert image -> Click on image

delete_button.action: Removes image from DOM and updates content

resize_handle.action: Drag to resize image maintaining aspect ratio

move_handle.note: Only appears for floating-image class images

critical_code_review_comments: Implementation is clean with proper event handling (stopPropagation, preventDefault)
Resize maintains aspect ratio correctly using width/height ratio calculation
Delete handles both standalone images and images wrapped in centering divs
Controls use overlay positioning relative to editor with proper z-index (50)
seed_data_creation: Used Curso demo project (existing) and test images from picsum.photos
context_for_next_testing_agent: Image editing controls fully implemented in RichTextEditor.jsx. Features: 1) Click image to select (cyan border), 2) Red delete button top-right removes image, 3) Cyan resize handle bottom-right for drag resize with aspect ratio, 4) Click outside to deselect. Move handle only appears for 'floating-image' class images. Access via: Dashboard -> project -> 'Texto com IA' button -> insert image via toolbar.
